name: SunSpec Common Model 1 + Inverter Models 101/102/103
doc_revision: SunSpec Alliance model definitions (github.com/sunspec/models, master branch JSON as fetched 2026-11-03; no revision number stated). The base-address / 'SunS' marker / model-header facts come from the SolarNetwork wiki page, a secondary source; the SunSpec Information Model Specification itself (sunspec.org) returned HTTP 403 and was not read.
notes: Built from the SunSpec model JSON definitions (point order and sizes as reported by a summarising fetch). NOT verified on a physical device. Address layout assumed: base register 40000 (0-based protocol address) holds the 32-bit 'SunS' marker (0x53756E53); other devices use base 50000 or 0 - shift all addresses accordingly (SunSpec allows 40000, 50000 or 0). Each model starts with a 2-register header (model ID, length of the rest). Model 1 header at base+2; with model 1 length L=66 (current JSON definition: Mn 16 + Md 16 + Opt 8 + Vr 8 + SN 16 + DA 1 + Pad 1 registers) the first inverter model header is at base+70 = 40070 and its data starts at 40072. The SolarNetwork example shows a device with L=65 for model 1; then the inverter model starts one register earlier. ALWAYS read the actual model-1 length (base+3) and model chain first; this preset assumes inverter model immediately follows model 1 with L=66. address_base is 0: if you use 1-based '4xxxx' numbering add 1 to these addresses in a manual, the preset's addresses are protocol addresses. Models 101, 102 and 103 share the same point layout (101: single phase, 102: split phase, 103: three phase); only the model ID differs, so one preset serves all three. Phase B/C and line-to-line points are not-implemented on single-phase devices. Inverter model offsets from model header: ID 0, L 1, A 2, AphA 3, AphB 4, AphC 5, A_SF 6, PPVphAB 7, PPVphBC 8, PPVphCA 9, PhVphA 10, PhVphB 11, PhVphC 12, V_SF 13, W 14, W_SF 15, Hz 16, Hz_SF 17, VA 18, VA_SF 19, VAr 20, VAr_SF 21, PF 22, PF_SF 23, WH 24-25, WH_SF 26, DCA 27, DCA_SF 28, DCV 29, DCV_SF 30, DCW 31, DCW_SF 32, TmpCab 33, TmpSnk 34, TmpTrns 35, TmpOt 36, Tmp_SF 37, St 38, StVnd 39, Evt1 40-41, Evt2 42-43, EvtVnd1-4 44-51. Offsets were computed by summing the sizes in the JSON order; point order was taken from model 101 and model 103 JSON (identical). Omitted for brevity: PPVphAB/BC/CA, TmpTrns, TmpOt, Evt2, EvtVnd1-4. Scale factors (sunssf) are dynamic: the preset shows RAW values and each *_SF point holds the exponent; the tool cannot apply them. Not-implemented sentinel values (e.g. 0x8000 / 0xFFFF) were not read from the specification and are not handled. String points of model 1 (Mn, Md, Opt, Vr, SN) are omitted because the schema has no string type (they occupy base+4 .. base+67). Device Address (DA) is marked rw because the model lists it as read-write; it changes the Modbus unit ID of the device. No other writable points are included. Connection defaults (port, baud) are not defined by SunSpec models, so 'connection' is empty.

points.name: SunS Identifier
points.note: Well-known marker 0x53756E53 'SunS'; base register is 40000, 50000 or 0 depending on the device.

points.name: Common Model ID
points.note: Model 1.

points.name: Common Model Length
points.note: L; current JSON definition includes DA and Pad (66).

points.name: Device Address (DA)
points.note: Modbus device address, read-write, mandatory for Modbus RTU devices (1-247 per SunSpec). Writing changes the unit ID of the device.

points.name: Inverter Model ID
points.note: Assumes the inverter model directly follows model 1 and model 1 length is 66.

points.name: AC Current (A)
points.note: uint16 * 10^A_SF.
